capabilities: Set vault-local images, GIFs, or videos as the workspace wallpaper
Adjust framing, opacity, zoom, blur, dim, vignette, and color overlays
Create reusable Scenes that save wallpaper and effect settings together
Route wallpapers or Scenes by note name, path, folder, tag, frontmatter, theme, day, or time
Build wallpaper pools from a folder and rotate them on a configurable interval
extras: Desktop-only. Detailed documentation lives in a separate Wiki rather than the README. Network access is used only for the optional Wallhaven browser, which is SFW-only and needs no API key; normal wallpaper playback is offline and collects no telemetry. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and it includes data backup, restore, import/export, and recovery tools.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to set a custom workspace background or change the workspace look automatically based on the note, folder, theme, or time.

relations.evidence: Search and import SFW wallpapers from Wallhaven directly from the Wallpaper Library.

summary: Workspace wallpaper plugin that sets a vault-local image, GIF, or video as background with opacity, blur, vignette effects, Scenes, and note-based routing.
